scientific.integrity: The primary open-problem statement and formulas were materially inspected, as was the later circular-isoptic follow-up. The new second-order displacement is derived analytically and replayed exactly by the packaged checker.
limitations: The counterfamily is perturbative; no optimal epsilon_0 is asserted.
Only the orthoptic angle alpha=pi/2 is treated.
The finite-epsilon orthoptic centroid is not given in closed form.

title: A Fourier counterfamily to isoptic Steiner-centroid coincidence
